title: Signer-first adoption/import and direct-runtime operator flow

actors.name: operator_signer
actors.role: signs public Nostr operator requests for adoption scan/import and direct runtime actions

actors.name: bahia_reactor
actors.role: authorizes operator pubkeys, validates request payloads, dispatches services, and publishes correlated status/result events

actors.name: operator_cli
actors.role: resolves signer and relay inputs, publishes signer-first requests by default, and uses HTTP fallback only before any relay accepts the request

actors.name: runtime_target
actors.role: server-managed runtime endpoint alias that scan/import/deploy/restart/stop operations act against

description: This slice covers the signer-first operator workflow for adoption scan/import and direct-runtime deploy/restart/stop. It includes public request event construction, scoped operator authorization, signer-first relay usage, validation that raw Docker coordinates do not ride the public event path, correlated status/result handling, CLI fallback rules, and sanitized DTO/result shaping.
in_scope: Public request kinds `5978` and `5979` for adoption scan/import and `5963` for direct-runtime `deploy`, `restart`, and `stop`
Scoped operator authorization via `adoption.allowed_pubkeys`, `direct_runtime_actions.allowed_pubkeys`, and `nostr.authorized_pubkeys` fallback
CLI signer-first defaults and relay resolution precedence in `cmd/cli/operator_nostr.go`
Operator client subscribe-before-publish behavior, correlated status/result handling, and explicit pre-acceptance fallback boundary in `pkg/client/operator_nostr.go`
Sanitized adoption preview/import result payload shaping and direct-runtime result DTO shaping
out_of_scope: Legacy privileged HTTP/NIP-98 execution as a primary product path
Encrypted browser request/result flows for notifications, orgs, payments, secrets, or run logs
Public service/deployment CRUD flows outside operator adoption/runtime actions
Human staged/live signoff execution against production-like environments
preconditions: Signer-first operator features are enabled in Bahia config for the relevant flow
The operator has a signer private key and at least one relay URL via `--relay`, `BAHIA_NOSTR_RELAYS`, or `/api/v1/system/info` discovery
Requested targets use server-managed `runtime.endpoints.<ref>` aliases on the signer-first path
The operator pubkey is allowlisted for the requested scope or covered by the global operator fallback allowlist
postconditions: A valid operator request produces correlated status and terminal result events or a validated terminal failure
Adoption scan/import results stay sanitized and do not leak raw Docker host values or redacted secret values
HTTP fallback is used only before any relay accepts the signer-first request and never after terminal signer-first failure

happy_paths.title: Signer-first adoption scan publishes a public request and returns a sanitized preview result
steps: CLI/operator client resolves signer and relay inputs
Client subscribes to correlated reply kinds before publish
Client publishes a signed `5978` request with trimmed target metadata and JSON payload containing endpoint refs only
Reactor authorizes the requester, validates targets, dispatches the adoption scan service, publishes `6978` progress, and returns `7978` preview DTOs

happy_paths.title: Signer-first adoption import publishes a public request and returns partial or full import results
steps: Client publishes a signed `5979` import request containing explicit selections or `import_all` when provided
Reactor dispatches import, publishes `6978` progress, and returns `7979` import DTOs with per-container outcomes

happy_paths.title: Signer-first direct-runtime action publishes `5963` and returns a runtime action result
steps: Client publishes signed `5963` content with `action`, `service_id`, `environment_id`, and optional `artifact_id` for deploy
Reactor authorizes and validates the request, emits `6963` processing status, executes the runtime lifecycle service, and returns `7962` with runtime observation data

failure_paths.title: Unauthorized operator request
failure_paths.behavior: Requests from pubkeys outside the scoped or global allowlist fail closed and return a terminal failure result without invoking the underlying service

failure_paths.title: Forbidden signer-first adoption target payload
failure_paths.behavior: A signer-first adoption request containing `docker_host` fails validation before service execution instead of exposing raw Docker coordinates on the public event path

failure_paths.title: Invalid direct-runtime artifact usage or unauthorized requester
failure_paths.behavior: An `artifact_id` supplied for `restart` or `stop`, or a requester outside the direct-runtime allowlist, fails before runtime execution

failure_paths.title: No relay accepted the signer-first request
failure_paths.behavior: The operator client returns a pre-acceptance error that explicitly permits HTTP fallback if and only if fallback was requested

failure_paths.title: Terminal signer-first failure after request acceptance
failure_paths.behavior: Once any relay accepts the request, terminal result failure is surfaced to the operator and must not trigger HTTP fallback

edge_cases: Reply subscriptions must be opened before publish and deduplicate duplicate status/result events by event id
Operator reply handling must ignore invalid signatures, stale/future timestamps, uncorrelated `#e`/`#p` tags, and duplicate reply events
CLI status chatter must go to stderr only in table mode so stdout stays reserved for final structured results
non_functional_requirements: Public signer-first adoption requests must never carry raw Docker coordinates in event payloads
Sanitized scan/import DTOs must preserve redacted key names while withholding sensitive values and managed endpoint docker hosts
Request/result correlation must be explicit via request event id and requester pubkey tags
HTTP fallback must be explicit and bounded to pre-acceptance failures only
dependencies: Adoption service and runtime lifecycle service implementations behind the reactor interfaces
human_decisions: Release approval for operator-only signer-first slices requires a stored local Docker+relay rehearsal artifact; staged/live SF-01 through SF-11 remain required for production enablement.
